Morgan Securities LLC, Mizuho Securities USA LLC, Santander US Capital Markets LLC, SG Americas Securities, LLC, and SMBC Nikko Securities America, Inc. acting as representatives of the underwriters. you.title: AT&T (NYSE: T) sells $6B in long-dated Global Notes maturing to 2066
you.snippet:
AT&T reported it closed a $6 billion registered offering of long-term Global Notes across five tranches with maturities from 2033 to 2066. The transaction was completed under an existing Form S-3 shelf registration and a previously signed Underwriting Agreement with several major underwriters. AT&T issued $6 billion total: $750 million of 4.750% Notes due 2033, $1.75 billion of 5.250% Notes due 2036, $500 million of 5.850% Notes due 2046, $2 billion of 6.200% Notes due 2056, and $1 billion of 6.300% Notes due 2066.
AT&T Inc. closed a multi-tranche senior debt offering totaling $6,000,000,000 in registered Global Notes. The company issued $750,000,000 of 4.750% Notes due 2033, $1,750,000,000 of 5.250% Notes due 2036, $500,000,000 of 5.850% Notes due 2046, $2,000,000,000 of 6.200% Notes due 2056 and $1,000,000,000 of 6.300% Notes due 2066.
AT&T issued $6,000,000,000 of registered Global Notes with maturities from 2033 to 2066 and coupons between 4.750% and 6.300%. All notes were issued under a long-standing Indenture and an Underwriting Agreement with a large bank syndicate.
